description: issue #687 (slice I8): with `interaction-events` active, redefining the profile primitive `wait` raises `ol-reserved-word` (`spec/tooling.md:186` -- redefining a *primitive* collides regardless of whether it is also a reserved block-head). `wait` is NOT one of the profile's four reserved block-heads (`spec/interaction-events.md` reserves only `when`/`every`/`on_key`/`on_click`), so this is the primitive branch of the rule. The span covers the declared name, not the `define` keyword. This is a check-mode fixture: it proves static legality only and does not execute.

diagnostics.message: wait is already part of OpenLogo. choose another name.
